ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and impact of childcare fraud in Minnesota, including the role of federal and state funding, oversight, and regulation.
questions: What is the extent of childcare fraud in Minnesota?
How do federal and state funding mechanisms contribute to the problem?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of public records and data can reveal patterns and connections between entities and programs, and I recommend pursuing this story to shed light on the issue.
